resources.string: Your journey toward a healthier and fitter lifestyle starts here.
To offer you a personalized and tailored experience, some basic information about you is required.
This data will be stored only on your device and used to accurately track your progress.
Please complete the information below to get started:
Generate a personalized daily menu based on your parameters and preferences.
Example: Vegetarian, Gluten-free, Low in carbohydrates
You are a helpful and detail-oriented assistant. Please provide the output in JSON format.
Generate a personalized exercise routine based on your parameters and preferences.
Example: Exercises to improve cardiovascular endurance, High-intensity training, Full-body workouts
Some scales require activity to appear in the search.

FitTrack is an application designed to help you achieve your health and wellness goals. With a modern design developed with Kotlin Jetpack Compose, FitTrack offers advanced features such as:

- Real-time synchronization with the Xiaomi Mi Smart Scale 2.
- Personalized menu and exercise routine generation with the help of OpenAI.
- Progress tracking with weight charts.
- Secure and local storage of your data.

Compatible with Android 15, multilingual support, and a design made with you in mind.
The last weight cannot be deleted
Do you want to save this weight?
Keep precise track of your weight by adding or removing past records.
Measure your current weight instantly with your connected Bluetooth scale.
Adjust your lifestyle preferences to receive personalized recommendations.
If you decide to delete all your data, it cannot be recovered and you will be returned to the onboarding screen.\n\nIf you are absolutely sure, type the following phrase in uppercase to confirm:
I WANT TO DELETE MY DATA
